_comment: The Amazon EKS add-on delivery option every new version of the Kubernetes agent's AWS Marketplace container product gets (Catalog API, AddDeliveryOptions with EksAddOnDeliveryOptionDetails; automation/aws_catalog.py). AWS publishes each version as Limited, in the EKS add-on catalog of the seller account's ap-northeast-2 (Seoul) clusters only, until it has been tested there on every compatibleKubernetesVersions entry and made public (aws_catalog.py --edition aws-eks-addon go-public). addOnName, addOnType and namespace can never change once a version has them. AWS prefixes addOnName with the seller alias in editions.json: {addOnName} below is that full name. EKS fills clusterName in with the cluster's name at install (${AWS_EKS_CLUSTER_NAME}). Description: at most 1,000 characters; usage instructions: at most 4,000.
title: Amazon EKS add-on
description: The OneUptime Kubernetes agent, installed and upgraded by Amazon EKS. It sends your cluster's metrics, Kubernetes events and pod logs to OneUptime over OpenTelemetry, with eBPF the traces and request metrics of every pod with no code changes, and runs read-only kubectl for OneUptime AI's incident investigations. This product extends the functionality of OneUptime, and without it this product has very limited utility: it needs a OneUptime project, on OneUptime Cloud (also on AWS Marketplace) or on your own OneUptime, and an ongoing internet connection to it. Guide: https://oneuptime.com/docs/telemetry/kubernetes-agent#install-as-an-amazon-eks-add-on
